points.label: Points per game
points.help: Average points scored (offense) or allowed (defense) per game. A lower defensive rank means fewer points allowed.

totalYards.label: Total yards per game
totalYards.help: Scrimmage yards per game. Offense wants more. Defense wants fewer yards allowed.

passYards.label: Pass yards per game
passYards.help: Net passing yards per game. The defensive number is yards allowed through the air.

rushYards.label: Rush yards per game
rushYards.help: Rushing yards per game. The defensive number is rushing yards allowed.

yardsPerRush.label: Yards per rush
yardsPerRush.help: Average yards gained each rushing attempt. Efficiency, not volume.

thirdDown.label: 3rd down %
thirdDown.help: Share of third downs converted. Defense is the share allowed to opponents.

fourthDown.label: 4th down %
fourthDown.help: Share of fourth downs converted. Defense is the share allowed to opponents.

redZone.label: Red zone scoring %
redZone.help: How often a team scores once it reaches the opponent's 20-yard line. Defense is how often opponents score.

giveaways.label: Giveaways per game
giveaways.help: Turnovers lost per game. Fewer is better.

takeaways.label: Takeaways per game
takeaways.help: Turnovers created per game. More is better.

sacks.label: Sacks per game
sacks.help: Sacks recorded by the defense per game.

tfl.label: Tackles for loss per game
tfl.help: Tackles for loss by the defense per game.

top.label: Time of possession
top.help: Minutes of possession per game. This is the offense's share of the clock, shown as minutes.

penalties.label: Penalties per game
penalties.help: Penalties called on the team per game. Fewer is better.

sos.label: Opponent win %
sos.help: Average winning percentage of opponents so far. An FCS opponent counts as a .400 win percentage. Higher means a harder slate of results. This is the plain record-based number, kept as a fallback. It is not SP+ schedule strength.

ats.label: ATS record
ats.help: Against the spread: wins, losses, and pushes versus the closing line. The rank uses cover percentage, pushes excluded. A line appears only when these two teams are scheduled to play.

ppa.label: EPA per play
ppa.help: Expected points added per play, from College Football Data. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense, because that is points allowed. This follows the garbage-time switch.

successRate.label: Success rate
successRate.help: Share of plays that count as a success. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

explosiveness.label: Explosiveness
explosiveness.help: How big the successful plays are. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

havoc.label: Havoc rate
havoc.help: Plays with a tackle for loss, forced fumble, or pass breakup. Lower is better on offense, because it is havoc allowed. Higher is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

lineYards.label: Line yards
lineYards.help: Rushing yards attributed to the line, per carry. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

stuffRate.label: Stuff rate
stuffRate.help: Share of rushes stopped at or behind the line. Lower is better on offense. Higher is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

pointsPerOpportunity.label: Points per opportunity
pointsPerOpportunity.help: Points scored on a scoring opportunity. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

fieldPosition.label: Starting field position
fieldPosition.help: Average yards still to go at the start of a drive. Checked against this season: a better offense starts with fewer yards to go. Lower is better on offense. Higher is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

standardDownsEpa.label: EPA on standard downs
standardDownsEpa.help: Expected points added on standard downs. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

passingDownsEpa.label: EPA on passing downs
passingDownsEpa.help: Expected points added on passing downs. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

rushEpa.label: Rush EPA per play
rushEpa.help: Expected points added on rushes. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

passEpa.label: Pass EPA per play
passEpa.help: Expected points added on passes. Higher is better on offense. Lower is better on defense. This follows the garbage-time switch.

spPlus.label: SP+
spPlus.help: Bill Connelly's SP+ rating from College Football Data. Higher is a better team. The rank is SP+'s own national rank.

srs.label: SRS
srs.help: Simple Rating System from College Football Data. Higher is better. It starts from margin of victory and adjusts for the schedule.

fpi.label: FPI
fpi.help: ESPN's Football Power Index, carried by College Football Data. Higher is a better team. The rank is ours, among FBS teams.

talent.label: Talent
talent.help: 247Sports talent composite from College Football Data. Higher means a more highly rated roster. The rank is ours.

returning.label: Returning production
returning.help: Share of last year's offensive production that came back, from College Football Data. Higher means more of the offense returned.

spSos.label: SP+ schedule strength
spSos.help: How strong the opponents have been, on the SP+ scale, from College Football Data. This season the feed left that number blank for every team, so the card says it is not posted.

fpiSos.label: FPI schedule rank
fpiSos.help: ESPN's strength-of-schedule rank from the FPI resume, via College Football Data. 1 is the hardest schedule played so far. Checked against this season: the SEC and Big Ten sit well ahead of the MAC and Conference USA.

remainingSos.label: Remaining SOS
remainingSos.help: ESPN's rank for the opponents still left, from the FPI resume. 1 is the hardest remaining schedule. Checked against this season: the SEC and Big Ten still have the harder roads.

strengthOfRecord.label: Strength of record
strengthOfRecord.help: ESPN's rank for how impressive this record is given the schedule, from the FPI resume. 1 is the most impressive. Checked against this season: the SEC and Big Ten rank ahead of the MAC and Conference USA.
